title: Combined Study and Practice Stays for Engineers from Developing Countries (KOSPIE) with Indian IITs
summary: Scholarship for Indian IIT students in engineering, mathematics, and natural sciences to complete a master's thesis project at a TU9 technical university in Germany.

degree_levels.notes: Students in the 2nd semester of their 2 year Master’s programme or 4th Semester of their 3 year MTech programme or in the 8th semester of an integrated / dual degree programme.

subject_areas.notes: The collected source does not establish this criterion.

institutions.notes: Applications for the KIT Campus Alpin, Garmisch-Partenkirchen cannot be considered.

nationality.notes: Restricted to students from Indian Institutes of Technology (IIT).

residence.notes: Country is the country in which you are living and from which you are applying.

mandatory.text: Applicants must be in the 2nd semester of their 2 year Master’s programme or 4th Semester of their 3 year master’s programme or in the 8th semester of an integrated / dual degree programme.
Applicants must have obtained a minimum of 8,5 CGPA.
GATE scores must be above average.
Letter confirming supervision by a university teacher in Germany (academic adviser).
A successful participation in a German language course at your host university is mandatory for further funding.
At the time of application, the applicant should already be in possession of a valid passport.
Very good proficiency of the English language is expected.

exceptions.text: It is not possible to draw funding from other German scholarship-awarding organisations or from other German public authorities simultaneously with a DAAD scholarship.

funding.description: Scholarship payments of 992 euros per month. Payments towards health, accident and liability insurance cover. 4 to 6 weeks German course at the host university. One-off research allowance of 266 euros. Monthly rent subsidy where appropriate. A lump sum travel subsidy.

required_documents.text: Letter confirming supervision by a university teacher in Germany (academic adviser)
One recent, supporting letter of recommendation from a university teacher
Detailed description of the research proposal for the master’s thesis agreed upon and signed by both academic advisers
University degree certificates indicating final grade(s) (CGPA /CPI /SGPA)

steps.text: Complete online application and upload required documents in PDF format

sources.title: Combined Study and Practice Stays for Engineers from Developing Countries (KOSPIE) with Indian IITs - DAAD - Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst
sources.notes: The scholarship funds international students from Indian Institutes of Technology to conduct research for their master's thesis physically in Germany at TU9 technical universities.
